description: Reviewed input-mass parity exclusions for the UK battery, scoped per reference build (microcosm#1095): each key is the <release>@<build> a cut compared with, and an exclusion suppresses only while that build is the cut's reference, so a promotion leaves it dormant. Each entry is a complete approval receipt (schema-2 fields per #610). The gate reports dormant entries, FAILS stale ones, and FAILS expired ones until the adjudication is renewed. The enhanced-FRS reference's three entries retired with it.

self_employment_gross_receipts.reason: microcosm#1550 (microcosm#1439) stops writing self_employment_gross_receipts: the trading allowance stage stores each trader's claim status and leaves gross receipts at the engine's zero, since neither the FRS nor the SPI records them. This build still carries the receipts encoding microcosm#1428 wrote, so a candidate built after microcosm#1550 carries none of that mass by design.
self_employment_gross_receipts.adjudication: microcosm#1095: María's ruling in session, 2026-11-10, on the PR that compares UK cuts with the current build of their line
